name: ブランド説明と複数分類を持つサイトフッター
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0115 ブランド説明と複数分類を持つサイトフッター.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: normalized-original-source-component-crop-740x425. Image 3: secondary-component-preview. Image 4: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Create one standalone Japanese Lighthouse site footer at exactly 740x425, matching the source crop proportions. Image 1 gives source context, image 2 controls the five-column/footer structure, image 3 supplies exact Japanese text and hierarchy, image 4 is the palette reference. Preserve all Japanese text exactly. Left brand column: 「ライトハウス」, tagline 「創作を支える道具。」, and paragraph 「創造する人を支え、物語を伝えるための素材や道具を届けます。利用しやすく柔軟な機能を見つけられます。」. Column 2: heading 「製品とツール」 with 「動画の生成」「画像の生成」「音声の生成」「音楽の生成」「制作ツール」「スタジオ」; second heading 「素材の一覧」 with 「音楽」「効果音」「映像」「動画のひな型」「色調の設定」「ツール」「音楽の連携」. Column 3: heading 「会社について」 with 「会社の紹介」; second heading 「法人向け」 with 「法人向けのサービス」「アプリでの利用」「制作会社」「放送とメディア」「スポーツ」「ブランド」「技術企業」「教育」. Column 4: heading 「参加する」 with 「音楽を提供する」「映像を提供する」「ひな型を提供する」「紹介活動に参加」「採用情報」; second heading 「ヘルプ」 with 「ヘルプセンター」. Column 5: heading 「資料」 with 「ブログ」「学習する」; second heading 「ライセンスと規約」 with 「ライセンス」「利用規約」「法人向け規約」「著作権について」「プライバシーについて」. Bottom row after a fine divider: 「動画・写真・交流・仕事」「外部サービスについて」「個人情報の共有を管理」「アクセシビリティ」. Keep the five columns and bottom link row; no social icons or added links. Use compact readable Japanese Meiryo-style typography, around 11-12px body with clear bold headings, balanced vertical spacing, and no large blank zones or oversized brand block. Use a pure white #FFFFFF surface, dark slate headings #263442 and readable supporting text #526173. The reference image and Japanese mock show a dark footer, but apply the current Lighthouse white palette instead. Do not add gradients, green accents, cards, shadows, mint wash, icons, artwork or watermark. Output only the footer component.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: The active palette calls for pure white footer surfaces and slate text. No CTA or active state exists in this footer, so do not add green accents. Translate the visible structure and exact Japanese copy only.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION:
The owner says the 354x44 LH07-0025 version was too large/spacious, while the 180x28 version was too compact. Use a comfortable middle with readable Japanese typography and balanced label padding. LH07-0025 v006 at 300x40 is the calibration for that segmented control only; never force this size or the prior 180x28 target onto unrelated components. Follow each component original source for anatomy and component-specific proportions.

BODY-TEXT READABILITY REFINEMENT (v002)
Refine the Japanese footer in reference 1 for readability at the exact normalized 740x425 size. Keep its five-column grid, wordmark, tagline, paragraph, all section headings, every Japanese link, and the bottom four links exactly where they are. Keep the white Lighthouse palette, dark slate text, and single thin divider. The only change is to enlarge body links and paragraph text by about 15% so they read clearly at 740px width; maintain existing row baselines and compact spacing so all lists still fit without wrapping or clipping. Leave headings and brand title at their current sizes. Preserve every Japanese glyph exactly from references 1 and 3. The source crop in reference 2 provides the outer bounds and spacing; reference 4 controls white/slate palette. No new icons, cards, accents, images, badges, or extra whitespace.
reviewNotes: Visually reviewed at normalized 740x425; body text enlarged after initial review, all footer labels and lower links checked, five-column structure fits. White/slate palette intentionally follows active Lighthouse guidance. Candidate image only; no native acceptance.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
